description: Get a short-term precipitation nowcast with 5-minute intervals for the next ~2 hours from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute Nowcast 2.0 radar model. Returns precipitation rate, air temperature, wind speed/direction/gusts, relative humidity, UV index, and weather symbol codes. Coverage: Norway and Scandinavia (approx 53–90°N, 20°W–40°E). Ideal for hyperlocal outdoor activity planning, event logistics, and real-time rainfall monitoring. CC BY 4.0 + NLOD 2.0, no auth, no upstream cost.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Coverage: Norway and Scandinavia (approx 53–90°N).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Coverage: Norway and Scandinavia (approx −20–40°E).

name: metno.weather.nowcast

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: MET Norway — Precipitation Nowcast (2-Hour)
